scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/api', { recursive: true }); for (const f of ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'app.js', 'core.js', 'db.js', 'supabase-config.js']) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); if (fs.existsSync('api/config.js')) fs.copyFileSync('api/config.js', 'dist/api/config.js');"
